title: it’s @Maybe Happy Ending the Musical opening night 🤖 I was so excited...
transcript: It's opening night. Maybe happy ending is officially open on Broadway. But what does that mean? After weeks of rehearsals, tech, and previews, their original musicals often make lots of changes when it comes to staging, even adding songs or changing scenes. Opening night is when the show is officially frozen, meaning the SO will no longer change and the critics can now release their reviews. Opening night is truly a Celebration for the cast, crew, and creative team to realize all they have accomplished. And for maybe happy ending, this was truly the ultimate Celebration. I saw maybe happy ending for the first time almost a month ago and I loved it. But so much has changed over previews. Every character feels more lived in, there have been line changes that make the show funnier, and they changed some of the way the show is staged. They also added a pinky promise which made me alright. No spoilers, but bring tissues. Maybe happy ending is such a unique, lovely story. The cast is incredible. Edible LED by Darren Criss and Helen J. Shen. It is going to be my go to recommendation going forward. It's a show that we truly all need right now. And the critics agree. It was universally acclaimed and a New York Times critic's pick. Grab those tickets to maybe happy ending!
reasoning: The reviewer expresses strong enthusiasm, noting the show improved over previews, calling it unique and lovely, praising the cast as incredible, and declaring it their 'go to recommendation going forward.' They also mention it was universally acclaimed by critics and urge viewers to grab tickets.
